set.s-numbers: Sino-Japanese numbers 0-10, 100, 1,000, 10,000, 100 million, with reading variants and sound changes (yon/shi, nana/shichi, sanbyaku, roppyaku, sanzen, hassen)

set.s-counters: Everyday counters and their sound changes: -ko, -hon, -mai, -hiki, -satsu, -dai, -hai, -kai (times), -kai (floor), -ban, -banme, -do, -en, -bai
set.s-clock: Clock time & durations: -ji (yoji, shichiji, kuji), -fun/-pun, han, nanji, -jikan, -funkan, -byou
set.s-weekdays: Days of the week, nan'youbi, heijitsu
set.s-dates: Days of the month: tsuitachi, futsuka ... touka, juuyokka, hatsuka, nijuuyokka, nannichi, -nichikan
set.s-months: Months & month counts: ichigatsu ... juunigatsu, nangatsu, ikkagetsu, nankagetsu
set.s-years: Years & age: -nen, -nenkan, -sai (issai, hassai, jussai, hatachi), nansai / oikutsu, -nensei

set.s-body: Body parts: atama, kao, me, mimi, hana, kuchi, ha, kubi, kata, te, ude, yubi, mune, onaka, senaka, koshi, ashi, hiza, kami
set.s-position: Position & direction the main list lacks: migi, hidari, tonari, yoko, soba, aida, mukou, oku, massugu, kado, kita, minami, higashi, nishi

set.s-countries: Countries, languages & nationalities: nihon, -go, -jin, amerika, igirisu, chuugoku, kankoku, gaikoku
set.s-taste: Tastes & textures: amai, karai, shoppai, suppai, nigai, mazui, katai, yawarakai

phrase.ph-greet: Greetings, partings & home rituals (konbanwa, sayounara, mata ne, ittekimasu, tadaima, okaeri)
phrase.ph-thanks: Thanks & apologies (arigatou gozaimasu, doumo, sumimasen deshita, moushiwake arimasen, gomen nasai)
phrase.ph-manners: Polite formulas (shitsurei shimasu, ojama shimasu, osewa ni natte imasu, yoroshiku onegai shimasu, osaki ni)
phrase.ph-ask: Requests, offers & permission (onegai dekimasu ka, ii desu ka, tetsudaou ka, dou shitara ii?)
phrase.ph-shop: Shopping & paying (kore kudasai, ikura desu ka, kaado de ii desu ka, fukuro wa daijoubu desu)
phrase.ph-eat: Eating & drinking (kanpai, oishisou, onaka suita, okawari, okaikei onegai shimasu)
phrase.ph-staff: What staff say to you (irasshaimase, shoushou omachi kudasai, omatase shimashita, kashikomarimashita)
phrase.ph-phone: Phone, messages & meeting up (ima daijoubu?, ato de kakenaosu, tsuita yo, chotto okureru)
phrase.ph-care: Care, sympathy & encouragement (odaiji ni, muri shinaide, taihen datta ne, ki ni shinaide)
phrase.ph-celebrate: Congratulations & seasonal wishes (otanjoubi omedetou, akemashite omedetou, yoi otoshi o)
phrase.ph-react: Reactions & exclamations (yatta, yoshi, uwa, maji de?, shimatta, mou!)
phrase.ph-talk: Keeping talk going & clarifying (ano sa, chotto kiite, dou omou?, sou iu koto ka)
phrase.ph-trouble: Problems & emergencies (tasukete, michi ni mayotta, saifu o nakushita, kyuukyuusha o yonde)
phrase.ph-feel: Saying how you are (tsukareta, nemui, onaka ippai, tanoshikatta, kinchou suru)
